warnings: Commentary on a Ray Dalio clip: Dalio's warnings are recorded as quoted third-party views; the host is skeptical of them (his record of missed deadlines is summarized, not extracted claim by claim).

Free-cash-flow and ROIC projections the host shows are analyst expectations, recorded as consensus views; the fiscal 2027 figure is negative (-37.7 billion), so it is kept in the reasoning rather than as a numeric target.
